paragraphs: From Dundalk Test Centre depart onto the Newry Road and take your 1st left.
Turn right onto the Racecourse Road and follow it for roughly 750 metres, watching for parked cars.
At the end of the road turn left onto the Inner Relief Road.
Continue along the Inner Relief Road to the roundabout and take the 1st exit onto the N52.
Follow the N52 briefly, then continue left onto the Newry Road.
After about 2 kilometres on the Newry Road take the next left onto the L20024.
Use the small unnamed road to complete a controlled U-turn.
Return to the Newry Road with a left turn.
At the end of the road turn left back onto the Newry Road.
Take a slight left onto the Fairgreen Road.
Turn left into Saint Helena's Terrace for a quiet residential section.
Head back out and turn right onto the N52, watching for Coe's Road on the left.
Turn right onto the Centenary Road.
At the roundabout take the slight left exit onto Saint Alphonsus Road.
Follow the road and turn left, then left again onto the L20051.
Turn left onto the L20018, keeping your speed low on the narrow sections.
Work through the unnamed link roads and turn right onto Jocelyn Drive.
Turn right onto Seatown Place.
Turn left onto the Castle Road and continue straight as it becomes the Fairgreen Road.
Take a sharp left onto Linenhall Street.
Turn right onto Northgate Street.
Turn right onto Bridge Street, watching for pedestrians and one-way signage.
Turn onto the Newry Road and follow it for around 600 metres back toward the test centre.
Ease off the accelerator on the approach, check your mirrors, and arrive smoothly at Dundalk Test Centre to finish the route.
